title: Honda x Team Liquid: Prelude
description: A collaboration promo bringing Honda's Prelude concept into Team Liquid's competitive world.
overview: Honda and Team Liquid come together in a cinematic promo built around the Honda Prelude. The film connects performance, precision and ambition across automotive and esports culture.
Controlled lighting, close vehicle details and the Team Liquid identity create a focused world that moves from the garage to the open road.
